study: B4 local neural restoration preparation; inventory and literature, not an inference benchmark

observations.collection: Sequential read-only local commands; not an atomic machine snapshot

file_inventory.root: tests/image (main worktree; not duplicated into documentation worktree)
file_inventory.method: Read-only filename/extension inventory; no RAW decoding, content hashing or camera reidentification

production_contract.camera_input: finite CV_32FC3, RGB camera, WB already applied, white 1, negative and above-one values allowed
production_contract.placement: after RCD/median, before LCP and nonlinear DCP on retained pre-lens path
production_contract.master: CV_32FC4 straight-alpha RGBA, linear-transfer Rec.2020 D65, extended range
production_contract.cpu_worker_policy: current CameraDenoise: at most 8 including caller, bounded by host and tiles; not a neural runtime budget

candidates.role: First rendered-RGB real-noise candidate; not a signed-camera model
candidates.declared_code_license: MIT with BasicSR Apache-2.0 notices in repository LICENSE
candidates.weight_redistribution_clearance: not established for a pinned artifact by this study
candidates.tile_caveat: Spatial pooling; ordinary tiled inference is not assumed equivalent to whole-image inference; NAFNetLocal is a separate configuration

candidates.role: RGB denoiser with noise-map conditioning; Gaussian-noise comparator, not validated Canon noise model
candidates.weight_redistribution_clearance: not established for a pinned artifact by this study
candidates.input: 3 RGB channels plus normalized noise-level channel in official color example

candidates.role: Second RGB real-noise candidate; transformer comparison, not a guaranteed quality or speed winner
candidates.weight_redistribution_clearance: not established for a pinned artifact by this study
candidates.tile_caveat: Attention includes spatial reductions; tiled result is not assumed equivalent to full frame

candidates.role: RAW-domain design reference only; Sony/Fuji weights not proposed as drop-in Canon restoration
candidates.weight_redistribution_clearance: not assessed; not selected for pilot

runtime_proposal_not_selection.reference: isolated author-framework environment, fixed versions, no execution of downloaded repository scripts during preparation
runtime_proposal_not_selection.deployment_candidate: ONNX Runtime C++ CPU/CUDA first on reference host; export/operator/numerical parity still to test
runtime_proposal_not_selection.alternative: ncnn C++ CPU/Vulkan if operator conversion and package constraints warrant

limitations: No exact model artifact or source revision pinned yet; upstream URLs can change.
Licenses listed are source declarations, not legal approval of redistributed weights and datasets.
No inference latency, peak memory, CUDA availability, model parameter count or exported graph size measured.
No blanket compatibility between pretrained encoded-RGB models and signed camera or extended Rec.2020 signals.
Corpus filenames/counts do not establish settings, independent scenes, ground truth or an untouched qualification set.
No local image, source code or host inventory uploaded in web research; web requests were generic public model/runtime documentation queries.
